name: Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 3
overview: Looney Tunes Platinum Collection: Volume 3 is the third volume of the Looney Tunes Platinum Collection. It is a two-disc Blu-ray release containing fifty shorts and numerous extras. Most of the set's contents were previously released on DVD. This is the only Platinum Collection Blu-ray release to be released as a two-disc set instead of a three-disc set. It was released 12 August 2014.[1] A two-disc DVD version was released 4 November 2014.
